title: The installer copies whole skill directories chosen by stack
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-skills-1115l.md slice 1
Why: the installer copies only SKILL.md and installs two fixed skills; no stack selection, no python stack (operator 2026-11-15: one universal skill system, per-stack skills).
Outcome: src/adopt/skill-set.ts alone maps repository facts to the skill set (core + one stack skill); writeSkills copies whole skill directories (lanes.md ships); first-test.ts detects python; drift reports a missing or changed skill file.
Files: src/adopt/adopt.ts, src/adopt/skill-set.ts, src/brain/first-test.ts, src/adopt/drift.ts, test/adopt/
